scope: 124 Minecraft Dungeons enchantments: player and mob effect facts, source support, Wiki status, and effect relation.

method.confidence: Confidence describes the strength of the reviewed Wiki evidence for the effect claim; it is not an in-game test result.
method.absence: not_found_in_reviewed_sources means no direct wording was found in the listed pages. It does not mean unavailable or nonexistent.
method.verify: Preserve the Wiki [Verify] marker even when the sentence is directly quoted.
method.relation: Same/different are curator comparisons, not Wiki fields. Require explicit source evidence for material trigger, target, duration, frequency, probability, and value details; omission is not proof. Use unknown when details are insufficient, evidence is indirect, or sources conflict.
method.schema: SQLite remains schema v6. Exact claim provenance is in facts/fact_evidence; this file preserves the fact-level audit excerpt and relation rationale.
